userDirection: Continuous ornamental patterns on skill and minimap frames, matching the middle supply belt style.
ownership: Project-original deterministic SVG adaptation of existing UiChrome.frame gold line scrolls and v13 supply panel. No new model generation, dependencies or external downloads.
construction: Dark inset wide ribbon with raised inner/outer gold lips. Continuous gold line vine and connected open return curls replace separated dark engraved acanthus crowns.
continuity: One closed periodic cubic Bezier path per texture. Repeat anchors carry shared rounded tangent vectors: previous control2 is anchor minus tangent; next control1 is anchor plus tangent. The final anchor/tangent is the same object value as the first. Open C/S returns are integral parts of the stem at repeat/half-repeat anchors, with no disconnected hooks or underpassing baseline.
sampling: Verified 10-level trilinear mipmapped non-atlased skill and map frames. Cocos-generated metadata is retained and enables mipmaps; fresh single-level engraved imports also initialize through the public Texture2D.image setter.
